verdict.rationale: Highnote is a card-issuing and payments platform that could plausibly offer a natural-language interface, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such capability. Its agentic-commerce material covers issuing cards to AI agents via API, and the llms.txt file is LLM-readable documentation. Both are adjacent developer building blocks, not a way to operate the product with natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
